score_contract.boundary_error: median |predicted point - observed interval midpoint| on finite observed intervals and point predictions only
score_contract.point_hit: point lies within observation interval plus historical one nominal log-force step tolerance; empty/invalid/censored predictions are not point hits
score_contract.censor_compatibility: separate intersection/containment counts, never point accuracy
score_contract.no_observed_band: legacy lower right-censor convention preserved and counted; not proof the physical band lies above support
score_contract.native_probability: original model probabilities; not changed by boundary extraction
score_contract.fewshot: not rerun; old results cannot establish an unbiased adaptation comparison
